description: Main entry point and root application widget for a Flutter app called 'Recipe Explorer'. It sets up routing, theming, and injects providers for managing recipe and favorites state.

classes.name: MyApp
classes.description: Stateless widget serving as the root of the application, setting up providers, routing, and theming.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point that initializes Flutter bindings and runs the MyApp widget.

methods.name: _unknownRoute
methods.description: Handles unknown routes by displaying a placeholder page indicating the page was not found.

methods.name: _onGenerateRoute
methods.description: Handles route generation for '/' and '/recipe-detail' routes, including validation and fallback behavior.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Build method for MyApp that sets up providers and MaterialApp with routing and theming.
